name: Abe Mikage
source:
[i]"If you want to peek inside my heart, you must show me your inside as well."[/i]

Mikage is an exorcist and he is working for the Emperor as a protector and advisor, never leaving his side. He has a suspiciously neutral but pleasant face, but he tends to rub people with wrong way with his words and he is reluctant to show his true self, which has kept most people around him at a distance.

I hear the people of the court are quite afraid of him. There are even rumors that he uses sorcery to beguile people that he exchanges drinks with the dead on rainy nights.

I'd steer clear of him if I were you!

[[url=https://shall-we-date.fandom.com/wiki/Mikage_Abe]From Hinata's notes[/url]]
